first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, so simplifying onboarding addresses the broadest current funnel constraint and has prior evidence of improving time-to-value and early adoption. Verify promotional pricing and activation messaging as credible alternatives before committing, especially given competitive SMB pricing pressure.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. The verified prior showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Activation messaging remains a credible alternative, but its verified gains were narrower. Promotional pricing is rejected despite competitive pressure because its +18% qualified-revenue lift came with 30-day retention down 12%, indicating poor downstream value.
